scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('../../packages/nlp/artifacts', 'src/assets/nlp', {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.predev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('../../packages/nlp/artifacts', 'src/assets/nlp', {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('../../packages/nlp/artifacts', 'src/assets/nlp', {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.build: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const ngPath = require.resolve('@angular/cli/bin/ng.js'); const p = spawn(process.execPath, [ngPath, 'build'], { cwd: __dirname, stdio: ['inherit', 'pipe', 'inherit'] }); p.stdout.on('data', d => { process.stdout.write(d); if (d.toString().includes('Application bundle generation complete')) { setTimeout(() => { p.kill(); process.exit(0); }, 500); } });"
